items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: You made those records with Lester in California in '45. I guess that was for Norman Granz, wasn't it? ... Yes. Yeah, right after that I got sick. So I didn't know whether Norman wanted me to stay with the group or not.

ctx.x: You made those records with Lester in California in '45. I guess that was for Norman Granz, wasn't it?
Yes. Yeah, right after that I got sick. So I didn't know whether Norman wanted me to stay with the group or not. But I wasn't able to anyway, so that was that.
